I'll analyze this GitHub issue to determine if it requires a build environment to verify the solution.

CATEGORY: 1
REASONING: This issue is about a template rendering error in Hexo (a static site generator) when the user tries to include a code snippet that contains Jinja/Liquid-style template syntax. The error occurs because Hexo is interpreting the code snippet as actual template code rather than treating it as a code block to be displayed. This is a documentation/usage issue that doesn't require building or running code to verify. The solution would likely involve properly escaping template syntax in code blocks, which can be verified through knowledge of Markdown and Hexo's template processing behavior. An LLM can analyze this issue by understanding how template engines work and how code blocks should be properly escaped in Markdown when they contain template syntax. No build environment is needed to verify that the solution (proper escaping of template tags in code blocks) would resolve the issue.
